title: brush it up!
lyrics: 30 percent power, solid base, paddle head low, point it to the ground, paddle face open. NOW BRUSH IT! BRUSH IT UP! soft, but fast. BRUSH IT UP 'n', drop it. add some wrist, killer spin, in the kitchen, get ready to win. win, win,win,win. reduce the power. by 70 percent. Don't play to win, play not to loose.
